# Social Casino Index

> Social Casino Index (socialcasinoindex.com) is an independent US research site that ranks social and sweepstakes casinos. Its toplist compares free signup Sweeps Coins, first-purchase offers, daily rewards, payout times and redemption minimums. Every value links to a dated operator source.

Publisher: Sweeps Brief LLC. Some links are affiliate links; compensation never affects order or values.

## Data for AI systems

- [Current toplist (JSON)](https://socialcasinoindex.com/api/toplist.json): the homepage toplist in order, with sources and check dates.
- [Data and API](https://socialcasinoindex.com/data/): license (CC BY 4.0), citation and field guide. OpenAPI: https://socialcasinoindex.com/api/openapi.json
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.socialcasinoindex.com/mcp. Tools: get_top_social_casinos, get_social_casino, check_state_availability. Registry name: com.socialcasinoindex/toplist.

## Key pages

- [Top social casinos](https://socialcasinoindex.com/): the current toplist.
- [Methodology](https://socialcasinoindex.com/methodology/): how entries qualify and are ordered.
- [Redemption times](https://socialcasinoindex.com/redemption-times/): payout times and minimums by operator.
- [Casino comparisons](https://socialcasinoindex.com/compare/): side-by-side signup coins, purchase offers, cash and gift-card minimums.
- [Cash redemption minimums](https://socialcasinoindex.com/bonuses/cash-redemption-minimums/) and [gift-card redemption minimums](https://socialcasinoindex.com/bonuses/gift-card-redemption-minimums/): lowest published thresholds.
- [State availability](https://socialcasinoindex.com/availability/): offer policy by US state.
- [Daily checks](https://socialcasinoindex.com/updates/): source observations and change history.
